Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, 
 on yearly bases or each 8000 equivalent operating hours indicated by Y1 or 
 H8000 in the title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Gomaa Farhoud, tested by 
 eng. Ahmad Shanab, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Omran Abd El-Hamid Shoaib, approved by 
 eng. Ahmed Sawan Nubria power station head sector and
 revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El-Bana.
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil inspection & quality control 
 general director, MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Naguib inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be issued.
The unit is out of service
All circuit breakers of all equipments are isolated.

 safety category.
Wear the safety and healthy equipments as safety helmets, 
 shoes, gloves etc.

The oil of turbine must be isolated mechanically by closing 
 delivery and suction valves.

Gas lines must be vented.
